width.description: Width of the output text line in characters.

from_encoding.description: Encoding of the input file. Empty string means auto-detect.

to_encoding.description: Encoding of the output file. Empty string means UTF-8.

indent.description: Number of spaces to use for indentation of list items and paragraphs.

paragraphs.description: Number of blank lines between paragraphs.

links.description: Whether to render links as numbered references.

images.description: Whether to render images with alt text.

nimages.description: Whether to ignore images entirely (alias for images=false).
